about: TCEQ's ids of Texas wastewater operators (regulated entity RN..., state permit WQ...) and the federal NPDES ids (TX0......) they hold: from the TCEQ Sanitary Sewer Overflows table's rows that give both (data.texas.gov 8kc5-95uk) and from EPA's Facility Registry Service, whose facilities list TCEQ's entity number beside EPA's permit. Individual permits only; only the entities and permits the TCEQ table names. Written by scripts/tx_permit_crosswalk.py.
